_meta.about: Curated catalogue of notable NON-QUEST unlocks (teleport networks, spellbooks, item/area access, QoL rewards) for the F1.2 dependency engine. Entry shape: name, cat (category), benefit (what it gives you), s = skill levels {Skill:lvl}, q = prerequisite quest names (gated via the quest engine; recurse into the full quest tree), d = diary prerequisites [{region,tier}], u = other unlock prerequisites (by name), qp = quest-point gate, note = caveat/extra requirement the hub can't verify (favour, drops, partial-quest), wiki = optional wiki page override. Gates are best-effort and many skill reqs are boostable; quest links are the authoritative part. Tracked as 'have it' per name via /api/state.
_meta.source: Curated from oldschool.runescape.wiki; high-value selection, not exhaustive.
